scope: One application home. Remove the old administrative homepage, preserve existing management commands in-place. No workflow redesign or storage migration.
changes: Deleted FormListView.vue and 64 management-only CSS rules. Retained six shared table rules used by records, permissions and payments.

Current form actions provide rename, duplicate, move, workflow, publication and recoverable archive. Sidebar provides group creation and recycle-bin restore.
Archive reuses filling leave guard. Cancel retains input; failed archive retains input and dirty-state protection; existing route discard and automatic retention remain supported.
Removed the development relation-demo installer button with the old page; actual relation configuration and existing demo data remain.
